promise: We plan to invest about $80 billion in AI-enabled data centers in fiscal 2025
description: Announced in a January 2025 blog that Microsoft would spend ~$80 billion on AI infrastructure in FY2025 (ending June 2025). Microsoft's actual fiscal-2025 AI capex landed in line with or above the target, backing the 'largest AI infrastructure buildout' claim.
evidence: Microsoft FY2025 (ended June 30, 2025) AI capex matched the ~$80B plan
Company confirmed more than half of capex directed at AI infrastructure

promise: A record $93 billion package to support the world's poorest countries over the next three years
description: In December 2021, the World Bank announced the largest replenishment in the history of its fund for the poorest countries, IDA20, with $93 billion in grants and low-interest loans for fiscal years 2022-2025. The full financing package was delivered over the three-year cycle, financing operations across Africa and Asia as promised.
evidence: IDA20 donors pledged the record $93 billion at the December 2021 launch in Seoul
IDA20 resources fully committed and operationalized over FY2022-FY2025, including crisis windows

promise: Tesla will offer fully autonomous rides with no one in the car by June 2025
description: On Tesla's Q4 2024 earnings call Musk promised 'fully autonomous' rides with no one in the vehicle by June 2025. The robotaxi service launched in Austin on June 22, 2025, but with a safety monitor in the passenger seat and only 10-12 Model Ys in a tightly geofenced area — a real launch, but short of the driverless rides he promised.
evidence: Austin robotaxi launch June 22, 2025 with safety monitors still in cars
Fleet of 10-12 vehicles, geofenced to a small area

promise: "I'll demand that interest rates drop immediately."
description: In a video address to the World Economic Forum at Davos, Trump said he would 'demand that interest rates drop immediately, and likewise they should be dropping all over the world'. The Federal Reserve held its policy rate at 4.25-4.50% through the first half of 2025, and the US president has no authority to set interest rates.
evidence: Fed held rates at 4.25-4.50% until September 2025 — no immediate drop
Analysts noted the president cannot order the Fed to cut rates
